title: Rates of Reaction and Collision Theory

flashcard_questions.q: A measure of how quickly reactants are turned into products in a chemical reaction.
A piece of laboratory equipment used to collect and measure the volume of gas produced during a chemical reaction.
A straight line that touches a curve at exactly one point, used to find the gradient (and therefore the rate) at that point on a graph.

flashcard_questions.a: The theory that reactions can only happen when particles collide with enough energy and in the correct orientation.
